note: Effect of the deterministic release guard, measured by replaying the recorded answers of the round with tools (prompt triage-v3) with the guard off and on; no provider call. 'notClearCutReleased' counts results whose expected decision is RECOLLECT or NEEDS_REVIEW that were released as non-critical. The limits of the guard come from the laboratory policy and were checked against the dataset generator, so its coverage of the dataset is partly by construction.
